sent.body: Thank you. About half the panel answered, and your answer was part of it. ACAPS used the panel's input in its update: Accepted. The panel and the export agree on direction; the spread is in the ledger with the minority reasons. The update informed Brief the Ouaddai field office before the weekly planning call for ACAPS analysts and the Chad response team, due 2026-12-01. ACAPS expects more than 500,000 people to be exposed to this risk (Risk List). It sits within Displacement from Sudan to Chad, which ACAPS rates High severity, 7.1 out of 10 (INFORM, Nov 2026). The risk materialised. ACAPS rates this High. The full view: https://sealed-signals.zaindroid.me/e/c2d65b6070014b2c/feedback

transport_note: No message left this machine. Every channel composes the real body and records it in the outbox; `transport: recorded` says so on each one. Replace Reach.deliver with a provider to send for real.
note: Only the experts who answered. No message carries the expert's own answer; they can ask for it from their own link. Email carries the full text; chat and SMS carry only the crisis-level line and the link.
